scopeNote: Left out on purpose: art. 1-2 use rules and flood-risk reference; art. 3 access and road widths (5 m, 6 m) and the 5 m gate (portail) setback from the alignment (fences/gates, not a building setback); art. 4 networks and the stormwater volume formula (60 mm/h x 0,70); art. 5 'Non règlementé' (lot characteristics, no in-scope kind); the art. 6 setbacks from watercourse banks (20 m from the berges de l'Eze, 10 m from other watercourses and canals), which are not distances from roads or public spaces; the art. 6 and 7 'Dispositions particulières' exempting extensions of non-compliant buildings and public technical works (described exceptions); art. 10 roof pitch 25-35 %; art. 11 aspect rules (roof pitch, 0,50 m fence base, 1,5 m awning depth, 30 x 30 cm pillars, window proportions); art. 12 parking (25 m2 per space, 2,30 m width, 1 space per 50 m2 of floor area); art. 13 qualitative planting rules; art. 14-15 energy and fibre recommendations. The zone sets no extension_max or annex_max (area) figure and names no sub-sector.
draftedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (a subagent), from the written conventions of the evaluation set
draftNote: Drafted from the chapter's text before any model's reading of it, by a model that saw only the chapter, the conventions and the product's definitions (never another truth, never a reading). Held-out zone of another document and layout. Judgement calls of the drafter: Art. 6 river-bank setbacks (20 m Eze, 10 m other watercourses) left out as not road_setback; a reader mapping all of art. 6 to road_setback would add two rules. | Art. 10 8 m ridge over 25% of the roof listed as a separate height_total limit though it is a partial allowance above the 5 m rule. | Art. 10 surélévation of existing buildings up to 8 m at the ridge listed as a height_total limit (figure-bearing existing-building allowance) rather than dropped as an exception. | Art. 10 annexes 3,5 m ridge height listed as height_total, not annex_max (annex_max requires an area figure). | Art. 7 annexes and pools 4 m from boundaries listed as boundary_setback (it is a distance to the plot limits, not a distance from the dwelling). | Art. 3 gate setback of 5 m from the alignment left out as a fence/gate rule rather than a building road_setback.
validatedBy: independent cross-check (a second model, Fable 5.2, that did not see this truth) reconciled by Claude Code; not validated by the owner

rules.quote: 10 mètres par rapport à l’axe de la RD956,
rules.note: Art. 6: minimum 10 m setback from the axis of the RD956 (annexes included).

rules.quote: 10 mètres par rapport à l’axe des voies et emprises publiques ou privées existantes, modifiées ou à créer,
rules.note: Art. 6: minimum 10 m setback from the axis of the other public or private roads and spaces.

rules.quote: Les constructions doivent s’implanter en respectant un recul minimum de 7 mètres de chacune des limites séparatives.
rules.note: Art. 7: minimum 7 m from each side and rear boundary.

rules.quote: Les annexes et piscines doivent s’implanter en respectant un recul minimum de 4 mètres des limites séparatives.
rules.note: Art. 7: annexes and pools at least 4 m from the boundaries.

rules.quote: aux autres sur une même propriété Non règlementé.
L’emprise au sol totale des constructions ne peut excéder 20% de la surface de l’unité foncière.
rules.note: Art. 9: footprint at most 20% of the plot.

rules.quote: La hauteur des constructions ne peut excéder 3,5 mètres à l’égout du toit (ou acrotère) et 5 mètres au faîtage.
rules.note: Art. 10: at most 3.5 m at the eaves (or parapet).

rules.quote: La hauteur des constructions ne peut excéder 3,5 mètres à l’égout du toit (ou acrotère) et 5 mètres au faîtage.
rules.note: Art. 10: at most 5 m at the ridge (same sentence as the eaves height).

rules.quote: La hauteur au faîtage peut être portée à 8 mètres sur 25% maximum de la surface de la toiture, avec une pente de toiture comprise entre 25 et 35 %.
rules.note: Art. 10: ridge may reach 8 m over at most 25% of the roof area.

rules.quote: Dans le cas de constructions existantes, une surélévation est autorisée jusqu’à 8 mètres au faîtage sur le volume existant,
rules.note: Art. 10: raising an existing building allowed up to 8 m at the ridge over the existing volume.

rules.quote: Les annexes à l’habitation ne pourront excéder une hauteur au faîtage égale à 3,5 mètres.
rules.note: Art. 10: annexes at most 3.5 m at the ridge (a height, not an area, so height_total not annex_max).

rules.quote: Sur l’ensemble de la zone et pour chaque unité foncière, au minimum 60 % de la surface totale du terrain sera traitée en pleine terre.
rules.note: Art. 13: at least 60% of the plot in pleine terre.
